Tooltip_EZC_ZombieCure: A single-use Medical 6 treatment. Use it on yourself to purge the Knox infection without healing wounds, or administer it to a prone living zombie to restore normal skin, remove gore, and pacify it. Crafting grants 165 base Medical XP.
Tooltip_EZC_RestorationSerum: A difficult Medical 10 treatment. It writes a physical record of a pacified zombie, then uses that record and the zombie's actual equipment to create a named, permanent, loyal Bandits companion.
Tooltip_EZC_ReanimationStimulant: A single-use Medical 3 drug. Administer it to a human corpse to reanimate that body as a hostile zombie with its original appearance and possessions. Crafting grants 20 base Medical XP.
